title: The Price of the Shackles
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was immersed in the shock of his new abilities, a sharp pain suddenly struck his chest—that was the resonance between Chen Nian and the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. The countdown to the seventh day of the third month seemed to have drawn nearer by another notch.

text.content:
Ye Qing's words were like a soft blade, seemingly harmless but actually piercing directly into the softest part of Chen Ji's heart. Beyond the chessboard—these four words he had never dared to think. Mo Xiansheng had said that the Tianji Record itself was a chess piece of the Heavenly Dao, so what right did he have to step out of this game?

The candlelight flickered, stretching their shadows long and short. Chen Ji didn't answer immediately, but slowly raised his head, and in those always-turbid eyes, a flash of sharpness never shown to others flickered briefly.

dialogue.content: The demonic mist slowly flowed around Ye Qing, her voice dropping even lower: "Yes, gamble. Bet that you can become the chess player, not a chess piece. The Holy Sect's Seer Inheritance... I've obtained a part of it."

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Seer Inheritance—that was the core will crystallization left behind by every Tianji Record holder after death. Mo Xiansheng had said that those who obtained the inheritance would have to bear all previous memories and karma, with costs so great that even major powers dared not attempt it easily.

And Ye Qing, actually offered such a treasure freely?

dialogue.content: I want you to take me to meet someone. A flicker of vulnerability never seen before crossed Ye Qing's deep eyes, someone else who was also used as a chess piece.

text.content:
The moment her words fell, a blinding golden light suddenly illuminated the secret chamber. The jade pendant on Chen Ji's chest vibrated violently, as if sensing something. That was—the Tianji Record itself resonating.

In the golden light, a illusory figure slowly condensed, the lingering will left by generations of seers, approaching its true master.

choice.prompt: The remnant will in the golden light is calling, the fourth page of the Tianji Record faintly appearing. Facing this rare opportunity, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: Endure the pain of memories flooding in, gamble on obtaining stronger foresight abilities.
choices.visible_cost: Bear the karma backlash, shackles deepening
choices.visible_reward: The fourth page of the Tianji Record appears, foresight range expanding
choices.risk_hint: The pain of memories flooding in could drive one insane

text.content:
The golden light suddenly engulfed Chen Ji. At that moment, he felt himself being torn apart and reorganized by countless consciousnesses—the memories of every seer at the moment of their death surged into his Mental Sea like a tide.

Pain.

That pain was not physical, but the despair of a soul being repeatedly crushed.

But Chen Ji did not retreat. He clenched his teeth tightly, desperately searching for his own thread of clarity within the torrent of memories.

He didn't know how long passed—perhaps three breaths, perhaps three years—when he opened his eyes again, the fourth page of the Tianji Record had fully unfolded in his mind.

choices.memory_label: 接受了夜清的预言者传承

choices.description: Before making a decision, demand Ye Qing to explain all the costs clearly.
choices.risk_hint: The inheritance timing might be fleeting

text.content:
Chen Ji did not act rashly, but calmly looked at Ye Qing: How much do you actually know about the price of this inheritance?

Ye Qing was slightly stunned, clearly not expecting him to be so cautious. But it was precisely this prudence that earned him a hint of true respect in her eyes.

However, the moment the fourth page fully unfolded, Chen Ji's expression changed dramatically.

What appeared on that page was not a vision of the future, but a long-buried memory—a memory about Chen Nian.

In the memory, Chen Nian was surrounded by Holy Sect experts, but she was not there as a captive—instead, she was there as—the core.

That mysterious altar constructed from countless formation runes, Chen Nian stood right at its center. There was a golden mark between her brows, identical to the runes on the Tianji Record.

The true vessel of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key was never Chen Ji himself.

But his sister who had been missing for many years.

dialogue.content: You finally discovered it. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed softly, The Tianji Record chose you back then because of the blood connection between you and Chen Nian. Only through you could it sense the existence of the Lock Key. And now...
And now, every time I use the Tianji Record, I am drawing from her Heavenly Fate. Chen Ji's voice was cold as ice, correct?

text.content:
In his Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was silent for a moment before finally speaking: Not entirely. The Heavenly Fate you consume does indeed come from Chen Nian—but it is not absorption, but... resonance. You were originally one entity with two manifestations; the Tianji Record simply made you the dominant vessel, while she became the hidden core.

Chen Ji's hands slowly clenched, his knuckles whitening from the force.

choice.prompt: After learning the truth, how should Chen Ji face this cruel discovery?

choices.description: Immediately stop the inheritance, avoid continuing to consume Chen Nian's Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_cost: Lose partial inheritance benefits, shackle backlash worsens
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily protect Chen Nian, preserve room for subsequent action
choices.risk_hint: Forcefully interrupting may harm one's own soul

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly severed his connection to the inheritance. Golden light scattered in his Mental Sea, and the fourth page that was about to fully unfold was forcibly suppressed.

The violent backlash caused blood to seep from his seven apertures, but he didn't even frown.

I would rather never use this damn book than gamble with Nian-nian's life.

choices.memory_label: 为保护陈念强行中断传承

choices.description: Since we've come this far, obtain complete foresight abilities.
choices.visible_cost: Continuously consume Chen Nian's Heavenly Fate, may accelerate her crisis
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete fourth page abilities, foresight range greatly enhanced
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's situation may worsen as a result

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging anger within him.

I need to see more. He said quietly, Only by knowing the complete truth can I save her.

Golden light surged again, and this time, Chen Ji actively faced the torrent of memories, actively enduring every ounce of pain.

choices.memory_label: 为救陈念承受完整传承

text.content:
The moment Chen Ji made his choice, the abilities of the fourth page fully unfolded.

It was no longer the vague three-hour foresight, but a terrifyingly clear vision—the seventh day of the third month, at the altar where Chen Nian was located, experts from the three Demonic sects and the Holy Sect gathered, everyone eyeing greedily the golden mark between her brows.

And beneath that altar, a familiar aura quietly lurked.

It was Ling Yuan.

dialogue.content: Old Sect Master... so he was the final mantis waiting for the cicada. Mo Xiansheng's voice rarely carried a hint of gravity, Chen Ji, do you understand now? You were never a match for Ling Yuan—from the very beginning, he was using you to approach the Tianji Record, using you to activate the Lock Key within Chen Nian.

text.content:
Chen Ji did not speak. He simply stood there quietly, letting blood slide down from the corner of his eye, yet a cold smile curled at the corner of his lips.

Fine.

Very well.

Ling Yuan, after all these years of waiting in this chess game, now it's my turn to make a move.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing. He suddenly spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm, On the seventh day of the third month, at the Holy Sect headquarters—I need you to help me with something.

Ye Qing slightly raised her brow: What?

Let Ling Yuan know that I, Chen Ji, will send him to his death myself. In those always-turbid eyes, a fire sufficient to burn everything was now burning.

choice.prompt: Facing the upcoming decisive battle on the seventh day of the third month, how should Chen Ji lay out his plans?

choices.description: Personally go to the altar for a direct confrontation with Ling Yuan, not letting anyone else risk danger.
choices.visible_cost: No backup support, facing multiple major powers alone
choices.visible_reward: Disrupt the enemy's layout, catching Ling Yuan off guard
choices.risk_hint: May fall into encirclement, nine deaths one life

text.content: Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then slowly nodded: I will provide support from the periphery. But remember—her voice became unusually serious, You are not alone.

choices.description: Unite with Ye Qing, Han Lie, and others to jointly oppose Ling Yuan.
choices.visible_cost: Need to reveal some hidden cards, may trigger chain reactions
choices.visible_reward: Obtain powerful reinforcements, greatly improve odds of victory
choices.risk_hint: There may be insiders among the allies

text.content:
Since we're playing chess, we must use all the pieces. A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's lips, Ling Yuan thinks he has accounted for everything, but he doesn't know that a true chess master never plays just one game of chess.

The fourth page of the Tianji Record slowly rotated in Chen Ji's mind, his foresight ability enhanced by more than tenfold. On the seventh day of the third month, he would make Ling Yuan understand what it meant to miscalculate.

choices.memory_label: 决定联络盟友共同作战

text.content:
Outside the secret chamber, the night wind was like a blade.

Chen Ji stood before the window, gazing toward the direction of the Tianqing Sect. That place which once required him to carefully disguise himself was now transparent in his eyes. Every move Ling Yuan made, he could see clearly.

But—he looked down at his own hands, where golden patterns faintly flickered, like invisible shackles wrapping beneath his skin.

The price of the inheritance was not just the consumption of Heavenly Fate. The karma left behind by generations of seers was slowly eroding his soul.

He could feel himself merging with the Tianji Record.

Or rather—becoming the next Mo Xiansheng.

dialogue.content: Nian-nian... Chen Ji murmured to himself, his voice carrying a warmth never seen before, Wait for me. This time, it's big brother's turn to save you.

text.content:
The moment his words fell, a sharp pain struck his chest.

That was the resonance between Chen Nian and the Heavenly Fate Lock Key—stronger than any time before.

Chen Ji clutched his chest, sweat beading on his forehead. The fourth page of the Tianji Record automatically unfolded, showing a blurry image: Chen Nian lying in some formation, surrounded by dense runes, and the mark between her brows was dimming little by little.

The seventh day of the third month.

The countdown was closer than he had imagined.
